title: Open Food Log v0: log
description: A person's whole food log as one file: what an export holds and an import can read. A server may add more of the person's record beside these keys; readers ignore keys they don't know. Draft; may change until v1.

meals.description: Every meal in the log, newest first.

foods.description: The person's own foods (usr:) that the meals name, so a reader elsewhere can resolve them. Catalogue and gtin: foods may be included too.

deleted_meals.description: Meals the person deleted, newest first, for a server that keeps them until the account is deleted.
